span.strong: 🚢 Welcome to Your Freight Management Adventure!

template.p: Whether you’re tracking services, freight places, routes, or steps, this guide will walk you through the key actions. Imagine you’re on a journey across a bustling logistics landscape – your Odoo Freight Module is here to make things as smooth as possible! 🚛
Begin by creating a freight record:

ol.li: Go to Freight > Click on Create 📄.

ul.li: Name: Add a recognizable name for your freight – something easy to spot in the list!
Partner: Choose the partner involved in this freight operation.
Responsible Person: Select the person overseeing this freight (you can even use their avatar! 👤).
Tags: Customize your record with tags (with colors too!) for easy sorting.

template.p: 💡 Pro tip: You’ll see a colorful progress bar for each freight to know if it’s in progress, completed, or blocked – stay on top of your freight journey!
Creating freight places is like marking essential pit stops on your map.

ul.li: Name: Give each place a unique name.
Contact Information: Partner’s phone and email – reach out with ease if needed!
Tags: Tag these places (colorfully, of course!) to keep everything sorted.

template.p: Use the Map View 🗺️ to see these places visually! You can zoom in and check where each location stands – a quick overview that makes managing freight intuitive.
Time to link places together into efficient routes!

ul.li: Name: Give it a distinct name to avoid mix-ups.
Partner Info: Add contact details for the route’s point of contact.
Origin & Destination: Specify starting and ending locations (with estimated distances!).
Route Cost: Add the currency and cost for tracking expenses.

template.p: 🎉 Bonus Feature: There’s a Route Page where you can add Sub-routes for those routes that have stops along the way. Customize this to suit complex logistics!
Freight Steps are milestones within your freight journey.

ul.li: Name: Give it a meaningful title.
ETD & ETA: Set estimated departure and arrival times for better tracking.
Current State: Note the current place or state (e.g., “On the Way” or “Arrived”).

template.p: This flow will keep you on track, ensuring nothing goes off course!
Every journey has its helpers! Services can include anything from maintenance to other essential tasks.

ul.li: Service Name: Choose a name that describes the service.
Responsible Person: Select the responsible person overseeing it.
Notes: Leave detailed notes about this service.

template.p: Now, add these services to freight records or routes to streamline your freight operations!
Stages help you monitor each freight record’s progress:

ol.li: Name each stage, like “Awaiting Confirmation,” “In Transit,” or “Delivered.”

template.p: Each record will move from one stage to the next, letting you see at a glance how far along each freight is!

ol.li: Filter by Date: Use the Start Date and End Date filters to narrow down your search.
Group by Partner or Responsible: Group records to view responsibilities.
Archived Filters: Keep track of inactive records without cluttering up your workspace.

template.p: And if you want to focus on your own assignments, the “My Freight” and “My Services” filters show records specifically assigned to you. 👀
Colors make it easy to spot priorities! Use the Color Picker on:

ul.li: Freight records
Freight places
Tags

p.strong: So, you’ll know what needs your attention at a glance!
